title: plugin
description: A Yonto plugin to install, as a type-50 entry carries it in `ext.config`: enough to list it and compare versions without downloading anything, and checked against the downloaded manifest before anything installs (kangzj/lantern-tv#606). Not a catalog type, so no handler receives it.

handles.$comment: Copied from the manifest, so a repo can offer the handler of a type without downloading every zip it lists (docs/design/2026-09-23-the-app-reads-every-index.md, *Types*).
